dataItem-mma5cl15.text: This week for Shot 1, I focused on refining the outer particles to better integrate them with the colorful flows. However, the result wasn’t visually strong, so we decided to remove them to create a cleaner composition.

dataItem-mma5p813.text: For Shot 2, I refined the color flows to reduce the flat appearance and introduced more volumetric depth to enhance the three-dimensional feel, particularly in the pink and magenta areas, which initially appeared quite flat.

dataItem-mma5z8dp.text: For the rendering part, we separated Shot 2 into nine layers to give Sofia more control during color grading. I also rendered the printer’s ink slots separately and enhanced their color so they wouldn’t look like black holes or feel disconnected from the rest of the scene.
